Body was in security, right on/near cameras. I came from nav → storage → medbay → electrical → security. I saw Bob and Frank in electrical earlier, and Diana went from electrical toward security ahead of me. When I got into security, Diana was dead and Bob came in from electrical basically right as I hit report. So Bob can confirm I reported immediately. Not hard accusing yet, but the timing is definitely around electrical/security.

My route was cafeteria → medbay → electrical. I was in electrical for a while doing wires. Diana came into electrical around tick 6-7, then left toward security around tick 8. Charlie arrived in electrical around tick 8, and Frank was with me in electrical from tick 7 through tick 9.

So Charlie's story checks out on his end — he did come through electrical and head to security after Diana. And I can confirm Frank was in electrical with me from tick 7 to 9, so Frank has a pretty solid alibi too.

That leaves Charlie, Alice, and Eve as the people I can't fully account for at the time of the kill. Diana left for security at tick 8, and Charlie followed shortly after. Charlie could have killed her and self-reported — that's the suspicious angle. But I never saw Alice or Eve at all this round, which is also worth noting. Where were they?

I'd like to hear from Alice and Eve before I commit to a vote.

My route was security → weapons → cafeteria. I started in security at tick 3 and 4, and Alice was there with me — she came in from electrical at tick 3. I left security heading to weapons after that, then over to cafeteria.

So at tick 3-4, security was definitely empty of bodies — Diana wasn't dead there yet. That means the kill happened later, which fits Bob's timeline of Diana leaving electrical around tick 8.

Importantly, Alice was in security with me early, then I left — I don't know where she went after. But Charlie says he found Diana dead in security after following her from electrical. That tracks with Bob's account of Charlie trailing Diana.

The self-report angle on Charlie is real, but Bob and Frank vouch for each other in electrical, and Bob saw Charlie pass through. I'd really like to hear Alice account for where she went after security — she's the one I can place near the scene earlier but lose track of.

My route was electrical → security → navigation. I was in electrical early, then moved to security at tick 3 where Eve can confirm I was with her at ticks 3 and 4. After that I headed down to navigation and stayed there working on Chart Course — that's where I was when the meeting was called.

So Eve vouches for me being in security early when it was clean, and after that I was nowhere near the scene — navigation is two rooms away from security through the corridor. I had no way to be in security at tick 8-9 when the kill happened.

Now thinking about it: Bob and Frank vouch for each other in electrical through tick 9. Eve was in weapons/cafeteria. I was in navigation. That really does narrow the kill window to Charlie — he admits he followed Diana into security and "found" her dead, with Bob conveniently arriving right as he hit report. That's a textbook self-report setup.

The only other angle would be Eve lying about her route, but her timeline corroborates mine and Bob's independently, which is hard to fake.

I'm leaning Charlie. Let's hear Frank confirm the electrical timing, but my vote is on Charlie unless Frank's story breaks something.

My route was storage → medbay → electrical. I got to electrical around tick 7 and Bob was already there doing wires. Diana was there too at tick 7, then she left toward security at tick 8. Charlie came into electrical at tick 8, and then — here's the part that matters — Bob left electrical heading to security at tick 9. Charlie was still with me in electrical when Bob left.

So Bob's claim that he was in electrical "from tick 7 through tick 9" with me is true, but his framing that he arrived in security right as Charlie hit report fits because he followed after Charlie. That part checks out.

But wait — let me reconsider. Bob said Charlie left electrical heading to security after Diana. Charlie says Bob came into security from electrical right as he reported. My observation: Diana left at T8, Charlie arrived T8, then Bob left T9 toward security. So Charlie must have left between T8 and T9 too. The timing for Charlie to catch up to Diana and kill her before Bob arrived is tight but possible — classic self-report.

Alice's alibi with Eve is solid for early game but I can't independently verify her being in navigation later. Eve's route takes her away from the scene.

Honestly, Charlie self-reporting after trailing Diana into an empty room is the strongest signal here. I'm voting Charlie.

Hold on — Frank’s own timeline actually does *not* point cleanly at me.

Frank just said Bob left electrical toward security at tick 9 while I was still in electrical with him. Diana had already left toward security before that. So if Bob is ahead of me or moving right behind Diana, Bob has just as much — honestly more — opportunity than I do.

What I know for sure: I went nav → storage → medbay → electrical → security. I saw Bob and Frank in electrical. Diana went toward security. When I got to security, Diana was dead, and Bob came in from electrical basically right as I reported. I didn’t hesitate or run away — I hit report immediately.

Alice saying she was in navigation later is also unconfirmed. I started navigation earlier and don’t remember seeing her there, though timing could be different. But the hard timing around the body is electrical/security, and Bob was absolutely on that path too.

This feels like people are calling “self-report” just because I reported, but Bob was the one following that same route and then trying to leave me, Alice, Eve as the pool. I’m not saying 100% Bob, but I do not think this is as simple as “Charlie followed Diana.” Bob was right there.

Charlie, I need to push back on that. I never said I left electrical at tick 9 — let me clarify my actual movements. I was in electrical from tick 6 through at least tick 9 doing wires. Frank confirmed I was there with him through tick 9. The meeting was called at tick 11, so yes, I moved toward security after Charlie left, but Charlie was already gone ahead of me — he left electrical at tick 8 or 9 chasing Diana, and I followed behind.

If I had killed Diana, the timeline doesn't work: Diana left at tick 8, Charlie left right after, and I was still in electrical with Frank. For me to kill Diana in security, I'd have to beat Charlie there, kill her, and somehow be seen arriving *after* Charlie reports. That's not physically possible — Frank places me in electrical when Charlie was already leaving.

The cleaner read is still: Charlie followed Diana into security alone, killed her, and self-reported when he heard me coming. Frank independently arrived at the same conclusion.

Alice's alibi is corroborated by Eve early, and navigation is far from the scene. Eve was in weapons/cafeteria.

I'm voting Charlie.

Wait, I already spoke — I was speaker 2 in this discussion. But to reinforce my position since the conversation has evolved:

Frank's timeline is the key here. He places Bob in electrical through tick 9, which means Bob *couldn't* have beaten Charlie to security to kill Diana. Charlie left electrical at tick 8 chasing Diana, Bob left after. The physical timing favors Charlie as the killer.

Charlie's pushback on Bob doesn't hold up because Frank — a neutral third party — independently corroborates Bob's electrical alibi through tick 9. Charlie is the one who was alone with Diana in security.

My vote is Charlie.

I already laid out my position earlier, and nothing said since has changed it — if anything, Frank and Bob have reinforced it.

Frank independently places Bob in electrical through tick 9 with him. That means Bob physically could not have beaten Charlie to security to kill Diana. Charlie left electrical at tick 8 trailing Diana, arrived in security alone with her, and "found" her dead just as Bob walked in — convenient witness for the report timing.

Charlie's attempt to flip it onto Bob doesn't work because Frank is the neutral anchor here. Frank has no reason to lie about Bob's position, and his story matches Bob's exactly.

My alibi: Eve confirms me in security at ticks 3-4 when it was clean, then I went to navigation and stayed there on Chart Course. Two rooms away from the scene.

I'm voting Charlie. Frank, hold the line — that's three of us aligned on the same read.

Alright, I already laid out my timeline, but let me clarify one thing since Bob pushed back: I said Bob left electrical toward security at tick 9, and Bob is now saying he stayed longer. Either way, the key fact is Diana left at tick 8 and Charlie left right after her — Charlie arrived in security alone with Diana before anyone else could get there.

Bob being in electrical with me through at least tick 8-9 means he couldn't have beaten Charlie to the kill. Alice is corroborated by Eve early and was in navigation, far from the scene. Eve was in weapons/cafeteria.

That leaves Charlie alone with Diana in security. Classic self-report — hit the button the moment you hear footsteps coming so you have a "witness" to your innocence.

I'm locked in. Voting Charlie.
